text: Audio line plays while the seated man mouths different words; the reply is attributed to the wrong speaker.
Watch dial shows pseudo-lettering brand text in a static product insert.
The red title characters on the file folder cover are malformed and mirrored.
The chest logo on the yellow delivery jacket is gibberish that mutates between frames.
In the same continuous scene the detective's shirt changes from plain dark to horizontally striped and the phone changes color.
The same dialogue exchange jumps from a dim lamp-lit apartment to a bright fluorescent office with no transition.
Door plaque reads 3207 in one angle and 2027/1025 seconds later in the same hallway.
A partial bald head of a third person appears at the left frame edge although only two people are in the scene.
Fingers of the hand gripping the drawer are fused and elongated, no clear digit separation.
Cut between two dialogue shots shows a +13.9 dB loudness jump.
The assembled episode is 99.6s while the sum of segments is 121.8s; shots appear skipped.
The narration plays as voice-over while the on-screen man's mouth stays closed for most of the clip.
The wooden tabletop flickers between light and dark brown across adjacent shots in the same room.
The man clearly wears thin-framed glasses at 00:00 and is bare-faced from 00:01 with no cut.
The pale healed scar above the man's left eyebrow vanishes once the angle shifts frontal.
Dozens of glowing red ring shapes float across the frame behind the two speakers.
The first frame of the clip is fully black before the image fades in.
The framed notice on the back wall contains garbled pseudo-Chinese text for the entire clip.
The old man stands at 00:57 but is seated again at 01:27 with no transition shown.
The low sustained drone music drops out abruptly at one cut and returns later.
